revision: User requests enemies face toward screen. Final generation prompt additionally enforces zero-alpha background, frontal chest in sweep recovery and 60 percent cell height.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production painted dark-fantasy sprite sheet matching the reference enemy identity, equipment, palette and anatomy EXACTLY. USER REVISION: All figures face TOWARD THE VIEWER/SCREEN, frontal combat presentation. Reference is ONLY for identity; redraw the front view. NO LEFT-FACING PROFILE. Center-line head, chest and attack direction toward camera. Genuinely redraw the articulated pose in each frame; do not merely translate or rotate a static figure. TRUE ALPHA transparent backdrop, no floor or shadow, no labels. STRICT layout: 6 columns by 4 rows, 24 equal square cells. Keep every figure AND every weapon/effect inside the CENTER 65 percent of its cell, at consistent anatomical scale; large transparent gutters between all figures are ESSENTIAL. No overlapping adjacent cells. Same foot baseline within each cell; floating creatures retain hover level. Full unclipped silhouette. Reading order left to right:
Row 1: attack windup; attack anticipation; attack impact toward camera; attack followthrough; counterattack defensive intercept; counterattack coil.
Row 2: counterattack riposte toward camera; counterattack recovery; magic gathering; magic discharge toward camera with SMALL contained effect; magic recovery; ranged physical weapon preparation.
Row 3: ranged physical weapon release toward camera; sweep winding torso; sweep mid swing; sweep extended impact; sweep followthrough; block brace.
Row 4: block absorbing impact; wounded hunched (persistent status); HIT distinct brief recoil; defeated lying prone/collapsed; preparing alert windup; neutral idle.
Attack/counter/sweep must have distinct anatomical movements. Ranged must be physical projectile, not the magic frame. Preserve sensible weapon grips, shield attachment, limb count and grounded feet. All 24 figures must fit grid with wide empty gutters, even prone figure. No text, no scenery. Highest available resolution.
